methods.label: Group by base-five place values
methods.explanation:
In base \(5\), each place is worth five times the place to its right, so the place values are \(1,5,25,125,\ldots\). Since \(25\le69<125\), the representation has three digits.

There are two groups of \(25\), leaving \(19\). Those \(19\) contain three groups of \(5\) and four ones. Therefore
\[
69=2\cdot25+3\cdot5+4=234_5.
\]
Each digit is allowed in base \(5\), and \(2,3,4\) are three consecutive digits. The answer is \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
